name: tpl-not-co-existence-2-nogoal
task: Never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Never both' is a hard NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open). key_lost is the drop-while-closed event the task names and door_open is the opening. The machine forbids either order, and the rule-only warning is valid because the task only restricts.

texts: Never both `key_lost` and `door_open` during the episode.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0

(u0, !door_open&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!key_lost) -> u2
(u0, door_open&key_lost) -> u3
(u1, door_open) -> u3
(u2, key_lost) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:

(u1, door_open, u3) -> -10
